cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Help me choose celebration glasses for when our café application gets approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the waiting list. I haven't even told my mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then just believe it with me here. Which glasses belong in our café?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These two. Mum would insist on a mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose her mug too. You just pictured our first customer.
